canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Calin Pellel: 28-year-old woman, 149 cm (very-short), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-4-medium. Face: broad oval face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; short rounded nose, wide mouth; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: multicolor-split-streak, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: asymmetric-patchwork, specifically intentional patchwork layers with an uneven hem, visible repairs, and practical trousers; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette moss-ivory. Visible personal details: an extensive matte botanical tattoo language over one shoulder, torso edge, and forearm. Make the hair construction the primary recognition silhouette. Maintenance cue: severe grooming softened by one unruly feature. Color treatment: uses small rhythmic repeats of the palette. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a clay tea token only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
